upload.title: Kmart Had 8x More Stores. Walmart Won Anyway. #shorts
upload.description:
In 1979 Kmart had 1,891 stores and Walmart had 229. The difference wasn't the stores. It was everything behind them.

Full documentary on the channel: The Machine Behind Walmart.

Source: Stalk, Evans & Shulman (1992), Competing on Capabilities, Harvard Business Review 70(2).
upload.comment: Full 9-minute documentary on how Walmart's logistics machine works is on the channel.
